name: capon_reach
aim: Extended CAP-ON run (EM_CAP=1, eta=-1, 700 steps, t=27.6 a.u.) so the WP-derived density reaches the CAP and absorption demonstrably begins. Decisive completing half of hypothesis (a): does ΔE(vs RT0) turn POSITIVE (the anomaly) as the CAP absorbs, or does the CAP correctly remove energy (ΔE<0)?
method: identical to capoff_floor/capon_matched but CAP ON (eta=-1), 700 steps. Same cell/GS/WP. Full energy decomposition + density_l2 recorded, write_every=5.

advisor_verdict.probe_reading: capon_reach (t=28, 700 steps): once density reaches the CAP, ΔE(vs RT0) goes monotonically NEGATIVE (-0.11->-5.4->-28->-88->-121->-138 eV), MAX=0.0, crosses_zero_above=FALSE, decelerating as l2->0.0001. Ledger EXACT (sum==E_total to 1.3e-13 Ha). CAP removes energy correctly; the phase-0 >0 rise is NOT reproduced in this clean single-transit at eta=-1.

ledger.evidence: CAP is the SOLE non-conservative term (off=>-0.015 eV conserved, on=>-138 eV drain, ledger exact). But the unphysical >0 excursion NOT yet witnessed under control.
v_bg on in both capoff_floor and capon_reach yet contributes no drift; isolating +v_bg-only control still absent.
sum==E_total to 1e-13 Ha; +221 eV is flat WP offset.
same ETRS/grid/dt conserve CAP-off; CAP-on drift fully accounted by CAP term.
8 components sum to E_total to 1.3e-13 Ha through full absorption; Sigma eps_i band!=total, benign.
